notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
Paradise Mantle attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability and Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid and Cinderhaze Wretch's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.
